rules: I took the Rams concepts from the p3 index of each section (05 to 25), in index order. The last index row (the section title pointing at page 3, or page 4 for Perimeter) is the index itself, not a concept, so it is left out. Titles are copied as printed with only the ends trimmed.

The system word comes from runs.json or pass.json: the concept's term when the Rams title or its concept word is that concept, or an alias of it (for example Zap Fup = Quatro, Race = Bounce, Barkley = Stanley, Faulk = Arches, Racer = Sledge). The protections in pass.json supply the words for the pass pro section. When the system has no entry the Rams word stays.

Install by lookup first: the concept word and run numbers are matched against the play name column of the Green Bay index pages (p104 to p370), tags in parentheses ignored, and the lowest install that lists it wins. Basis is then 'gb-index pNNN'.

A Rams-only concept goes where its closest Green Bay sibling first appears: the same family and the same kind of adjustment. The base call goes where the family's base goes; a gun-only call goes where the family's gun calls go; a Can run or pass goes with its base run.

A Fly, Flight, Flow or Flock version (the motion word in the title, not in parentheses, or the book defines the concept as a fly or flow motion run) goes where Green Bay first lists that family with Fly motion, counting the formation columns of the index tables: outside zone install 4 (Wendy, p256), inside zone install 2 (Wash, p158), gap install 4 (Counter, p256), specials install 1, play pass install 3 (Willie Strike Swirl, p236), screens install 2 (William, p184). Movement has none, so a fly keeper goes with the first tagged keeper. When runs.json or pass.json gives the fly version as an explicit alias of a system concept (14 / 15 F Sift Fly-Flight, 14 / 15 Fly-Flight Ice, Keep Fly Sift Skate), that concept's own install wins.

Mid zone (16 / 17, 36 / 37) has no Green Bay family. It is treated like the Green Bay outside zone family one install later: base 16 / 17 and the base open side call 17 / 16 Wanda are install 2, the other words are install 3 and up (the outside zone sibling plus one), fly and flow versions are install 5. Gun only mid zone (37 / 36) is install 3, its flow version 5. Its group is Outside zone because that is the family it is treated as.
Dive zone and zone read (31 / 30) go with Green Bay's inside zone gun calls, install 2 (p158).

Red zone, two minute, situational (backed up, four minute, scramble), run alerts and pass protections are situations, not installs. They get a situation value and the install where Green Bay first installs that situation: protections 1, red zone 1, run alerts 2, two minute 6, backed up and four minute 6. The field scramble rules have no situation value in the list, so situation is null and they stay with the install 6 situational block; the red zone scramble rules go with red zone. Basis is 'section'. Where Green Bay lists the same word on a later index the note says so.
When nothing fits, a run gets install 4 and a pass gets install 5, and the note says so (Samurai / Sensei / Shredder, Braves, Steal New York, Glider Usher, Mexico).

The group is the Green Bay index heading the concept (or its sibling) sits under. Backed up, four minute and the field scramble rules have no Green Bay heading and are grouped with Two minute, the install 6 situational block.
Every Rams index concept appears exactly once, in index order inside each section. Two index rows that name the same system concept (for example Faulk 2x2 and Faulk 3x1) each keep their own entry.
